name: K Z Leasing and Finance Limited
about: K Z Leasing and Finance Limited operates as a non-banking financial company in India. The company offers MSME finance services for micro entrepreneurs; customized and flexible loans for new and used two-wheeler vehicles; individual and small business loans for three-wheeled vehicles; new and used four-wheeler loans; personal loans; home loans; gold loans; agriculture loans; leasing; and microfinance services for entrepreneurs and small businesses. K Z Leasing and Finance Limited was incorporated in 1986 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
